as_of_content:
[[File:Portrait relic raid t4 large.png|thumb]]

==Description==
''Respected by Autobots and Decepticons alike and earned only through the hardships of battle,'' ''this relic is considered a warning sign to intruders that no offense will go without retaliation.''
==Relic Boosts==
*+4% Attack and Health in Raids.
==Obtainment==
Introduced in v6.0, this high-end Relic can be bought if the Commander has 1,500 [[Medal]]s and 1,000,000 [[Raid Chip|Raid Chips]]. (Limit 1 in 7 days)
==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Portrait relic raid t1 small.jpg|Unreleased Tier 1 Raid Relic
File:Portrait relic raid t1 large.png|Unreleased Tier 1 Raid Relic portrait
File:Portrait relic raid t2 small.jpg|Unreleased Tier 2 Raid Relic
File:Portrait relic raid t2 large.png|Unreleased Tier 2 Raid Relic portrait
File:Portrait relic raid t3 small.jpg|Unreleased Tier 3 Raid Relic
File:Portrait relic raid t3 large.png|Unreleased Tier 3 Raid Relic portrait
File:Gold Raid Trophy icon.jpg
File:Portrait relic raid t4 large.png
</gallery>

== Notes==
*This Relic is similar to the early [[Star Saber]] in exclusivity and cost.
*There are four tiers of this relic in the game files, but only the gold highest-tier one is in the game.
[[Category:Relics]]
